channel.title: Christopher R McGuire's Blog
channel.description: Essays and insights on UX/UI design, software engineering leadership, fintech systems, and applied AI.

item.title: Why FinTech Companies Need Dedicated UX Teams (not 'a designer when we have time')
item.description: Fintech UX drives revenue, retention, and regulatory compliance. A 20-year industry perspective on why dedicated UX teams outperform ad hoc design support.

item.title: Building AI Products With UX Rigor
item.description: AI products fail less from model quality and more from weak product framing. This framework keeps intent, UX, and engineering quality aligned from day one.

item.title: Designing Application Icons: Tips and Tricks for Success
item.description: Explore expert tips and practical strategies for designing application icons that stand out across grid systems, metaphors, and production delivery.

item.title: The Hidden ROI of UX/UI Design in Internal Business Applications
item.description: Internal tools rarely get the design attention they deserve. The cost shows up in lost productivity, higher training overhead, and employees fighting software daily.

item.title: Mastering UI/UX Design in Modern Application Development
item.description: Modern application development demands design that is research-driven, systematized, and tested with real users across the full product lifecycle.

item.title: Custom Icons and User Interface Design Tips and Methods
item.description: Elevate your digital product with custom iconography that reinforces brand identity, improves scanability, and maintains stroke harmony at every scale.

item.title: User Interface Design for Web Applications | Best Practices
item.description: Discover essential best practices for web application UI design—combining visual hierarchy, responsive patterns, accessibility, and frontend speed.

item.title: The Impact of Job Titles in Software Engineering: Pitfalls and Solutions
item.description: Job titles shape careers, compensation benchmarks, and hiring pipelines. When treated as an afterthought, ambiguity compounds across the organization.

item.title: The Mythical 'Full Stack' Developer
item.description: The full stack unicorn is often a recruiting shortcut that dilutes quality on both ends. Strong products emerge from deep specialists collaborating across clean contracts.

item.title: Frontend Development: Not Just About a 'Pretty' Website
item.description: Frontend engineering is the software discipline connecting users to your product—governing state, accessibility, performance, and component architecture.
